name: colors
description: Colors: the 76 Pancakes engine (TypeScript: core, sports/nfl engine/app/view, platform adapters). Engine, app and view code import no framework. npm test needs the WHOLE repo checked out (tests read ../data and ../tools). There is no app entry yet: dev/build/preview run Vite against index.html, which points at src/main.ts, which does not exist, so npm run build fails until the UI shell is merged. react, react-dom, svelte, vite and @sveltejs/vite-plugin-svelte stay installed as framework-test candidates (nothing in src, test or tools imports them); the framework verdict belongs to the council test. The old esbuild bundler (build/build.mjs) was removed on 2026-11-13.
